entry.title: Custom field addition in Class Assignment (CLASSASGN) entity in MDG-M
entry.content:
Hi,

We have extended the standard MM data model by adding a custom Z-attribute to the CLASSASGN entity type. The field represents a direct attribute of the Class Assignment itself. We have successfully appended this field across the backend persistence structures, the SPI structures, and mapped it to the COMPONENTCONTROLLER context node of /PLMU/WDC_CLF.

The field displays correctly on the UI layout, is input-enabled, and successfully persists its value to the MDG staging tables upon saving the Change Request.
However, we are encountering a critical data loss issue during active UI runtime interactions. Whenever a user modifies a Characteristic Value or deletes a class row, the value inside our custom Z-field is completely wiped out (initialized) from the screen buffer before the controller methods are reached.

BAdI Implementation & Technical Bottleneck:
To resolve this, we implemented the SPI enhancement spot /PLMB/ES_SPI via BAdI /PLMB/EX_SPI_APPL_ACCESS using methods AFTER_RETRIEVE and MODIFY_BEFORE_UPDATE.
We attempt to re-read the data via the MDG Model API (CL_USMD_MODEL_EXT=>GET_INSTANCE) inside these BAdI methods to manually restore the value. However, even though the data safely exists in the database staging tables, the Model API explicitly returns a blank value in our Z-field during this specific runtime event loop.

Kindly provide your valuable inputs/ guidance on how we can achieve this functionality.

entry.title: France E-Invoicing: Standard Solution for Mass Maintenance of BP Identification and Tax Data?
entry.content:
Hello to everyone, 

We are currently preparing our SAP S/4HANA On-Premise 2025 system for the upcoming French e-invoicing requirements and have identified a significant master data challenge.

To ensure that e-invoicing works correctly for France, all relevant Business Partners (BPs) must have the following data properly maintained:

  • SIREN (FR2) and/or SIRET (FR1) tax numbers
  • Tax Registration Status
  • Identification Type
  • Identification Number

    The challenge we are facing is finding a standard and centralized SAP solution to mass upload and mass maintain this information for a large number of Business Partners.

    So far, we are aware of the following options:

    • A BAPI that can be used to create or change tax numbers. With the implementation of a specific SAP Note, updating the Tax Registration Status is also possible.
    • The Fiori App F2505 - Mass Maintenance for Master Data, which can be used for certain BP mass maintenance scenarios.

       

However, we are unsure whether SAP provides a standard end-to-end solution that centrally supports the mass maintenance of all the required French e-invoicing attributes, including tax numbers, tax registration status, identification types, and identification numbers.

Considering that French e-invoicing requirements affect all SAP customers conducting business in France, we would expect there to be a recommended or standardized SAP approach for maintaining this data at scale.

Has anyone already implemented this requirement in S/4HANA and identified a standard SAP solution or best practice for the mass upload and maintenance of these Business Partner fields?

Any guidance or recommendations would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you in advance.

entry.title: SAP MDG Public Cloud – Dynamic Workflow Approver Determination
entry.content:
Hi Experts,

We are working on SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition – Master Data Governance (Business Partner/Supplier) and have a requirement to determine workflow approvers dynamically.

Requirement

We need to route the approval workflow dynamically based on Business Partner attributes.

For example:

  • If BP Country = US, route the workflow to Approver/Group A.

  • If BP Country = IN, route the workflow to Approver/Group B.

We also have a similar requirement based on Business Partner Role, for example:

  • FLVN00 → Approver A

  • FLCU00 → Approver B

We are using SAP Build Process Automation (SBPA) for the approval workflow.

Issue

The required Business Partner attributes, such as Country or BP Role, are not directly available in the workflow context for dynamic routing.

We explored reading the Business Partner information using APIs/OData services, including:

C_BusinessPartnerGovTP_V4

However, we are facing challenges exposing/consuming the required service from SAP Build Process Automation through the available communication scenarios.

We checked communication scenarios such as:

  • SAP_COM_0008

  • SAP_COM_0A61

  • SAP_COM_0A79

but could not identify a standard approach that exposes all the information required for our workflow determination.

Questions

Has anyone implemented dynamic approver determination in SAP MDG Public Cloud / S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition using SAP Build Process Automation?

Specifically:

  1. What is the recommended way to retrieve BP Country or BP Role during workflow execution?

  2. Is there a standard API/service that can be consumed from SBPA for this purpose?

  3. Is there a recommended communication scenario for accessing the required Business Partner governance data?

  4. Can approver determination be configured dynamically without maintaining custom persistence/configuration?

  5. If custom logic is required, what is the recommended SAP Public Cloud extensibility approach?

Any examples or guidance from similar implementations would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks in advance.

entry.title: SAP B1 – Address components empty although formatted address is visible (ZUGFeRD issue)
entry.content:
Hello SAP Community,

we are experiencing an issue in SAP Business One with the billing address information in some existing sales documents.

We are Running SAP B1 SQL 10.00.320 FP2602

 

Problem description

In affected sales orders, deliveries and A/R invoices, the billing address is displayed correctly as formatted text in the Logistics tab.

However, when opening the address components using the [...] button, all structured address fields are empty, including:

  • Street

  • City

  • ZIP Code

  • Country

  • Other address components

The formatted address is still visible and correctly printed on the invoice PDF.

Impact on ZUGFeRD / EN 16931

When generating the ZUGFeRD invoice, the XML contains the buyer name and customer ID, but the entire PostalTradeAddress element under BuyerTradeParty is missing.

As a result, the electronic invoice fails validation because the structured buyer address is missing.

What we have checked

  • The billing address is correctly maintained in the Business Partner master data.

  • The issue occurs in multiple existing documents and for at least two different customers.

  • Sales orders, deliveries and A/R invoices are affected.

  • In a newly created document, all address components were correctly populated.

  • The issue therefore seems to affect only certain existing documents.

Possible technical cause

According to the SAP Business One SDK documentation, there is a distinction between the formatted address (Address) and the structured address fields (AddressExtension).

We suspect that the structured address information might have been cleared or not transferred correctly during document creation, copying or updating, while the formatted address text was retained.

Questions

  1. Has anyone experienced this behavior in SAP Business One?

  2. Are there known SAP Notes or bugs related to missing AddressExtension data in existing marketing documents?

  3. Can the structured address components be lost when copying a sales order into a delivery or A/R invoice?

  4. Could this be caused by an SDK/DI API integration or by modifying the formatted address?

  5. Is there a supported way to restore missing structured address components in existing documents without directly modifying the database?

Any suggestions would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you in advance!
